cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern
Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant // Phoenix, Warden of Fire
Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, the Mothercrystal
Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen
Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming

Mog, Moogle Warrior.text: In the deck (owner's pick). An end-step discard every turn for madness and the discard payoffs, plus Moogle tokens and counters; every player may loot too, so opponents filter as well.

Rakdos, the Muscle.text: In the deck (owner's pick). A flying trampler that sacrifices to itself for indestructible; the exile trigger scales with the sacrificed creature's mana value, so tokens give nothing.

Phyrexian Dragon Engine.text: Unearth returns it from the GRAVEYARD, which Zuko does not count; the discard-hand-draw-three is Celes-shaped value, not the exile engine.

Angrath, the Flame-Chained.text: +1 makes the OPPONENT discard, which feeds none of our discard payoffs; a good walker, but off-axis here.

Long Goodbye.text: Uncounterable 2-mana removal; left out only for slots (16 answers already). First interaction add if one underperforms.

Massacre Girl, Most Wanted.text: Death payoff; this list kills few of its own creatures, so it would be a 5-mana pinger.

Zagras, Thief of Heartbeats.text: Party discount and team deathtouch; no tie to discard or exile.

Boneyard Desecrator.text: Outlaw-sacrifice Treasure maker, but the deck has no sacrifice plan.

Outlaws' Merriment.text: A random Human token every upkeep; steady value, nothing to do with the engine.

Ertha Jo, Frontier Mentor.text: Copies targeted activated abilities — Nico's and Liliana's would qualify, but that is two cards.

Alpharael, Stonechosen.text: Void needs a warp or a permanent leaving; only All-Fates Stalker warps here.

Genji Glove.text: Extra combat equipment; no attack-trigger core in this deck.

Vraan, Executioner Thane.text: Death drain; same problem as Massacre Girl — few deaths.

Avacyn's Judgment.text: Cut for Liliana the Faultless. Madness {X}{R} splits X damage among creatures — cast from exile, so a Zuko counter too.

Bloodhall Priest.text: Cut for Boros Charm. Madness body that pings on entering or attacking, but only with an EMPTY hand, which this deck rarely has.

Alchemist's Greeting.text: 4 damage to a creature for {1}{R} on madness; a strong discard-outlet removal spell.

Kitchen Imp.text: {B} madness 2/2 flying haste — the cheapest Zuko trigger in the pool.

Gisa's Bidding.text: Two 2/2 Zombies for {2}{B} on madness; bodies to carry Zuko's counters.

Cryptcaller Chariot.text: A tapped 2/2 Zombie per card discarded, and it crews itself from them.

Green Goblin, Revenant.text: Flying deathtouch; on attack discard one, then draw for each card discarded this turn — grows with Inti and Conspiracy Theorist.

Hobgoblin, Mantled Marauder.text: Flying haste 2-drop that gets +2/+0 per discard; an evasive clock.

Ivora, Insatiable Heir.text: Grows per discard and makes Blood tokens (outlets).

Marauding Mako.text: One-mana Pirate (outlaw) that grows per discard.

Necropotence.text: Huge card advantage; its discards are exiled but NOT castable, so it fights Containment Construct / Moonstone for the same cards.

Currency Converter.text: Loot rock; exiled discards come back as Treasures or 2/2 Rogues (outlaws).

Kitesail Freebooter.text: Pirate flier that strips a noncreature spell from their hand.

Hellspur Posse Boss.text: Haste for outlaws plus two Mercenaries; the outlaw axis is light, so this has few targets.

Vial Smasher, Gleeful Grenadier.text: Pings when another outlaw enters; about ten outlaws here.

Foulmire Knight // Profane Insight.text: Adventure draw, then the deathtouch 1-drop cast from exile — a Zuko trigger.

Order of Midnight // Alter Fate.text: Regrow a creature, then the flier cast from exile.

Realm-Cloaked Giant // Cast Off.text: Board wipe from an adventure; kills our own board, so only as a reset.

Reckless Impulse.text: Two cards from exile for {1}{R}; a cheaper Light Up the Stage.

Valakut Exploration.text: Every land drop is a card played from exile; leftover cards burn the opponent.

Appa, Steadfast Guardian.text: Flash flier that airbends your own permanents (they re-cast from exile for {2}) and makes an Ally per exile cast; heavy white ({2}{W}{W}).

Tannuk, Steadfast Second.text: In the deck. Red creatures and artifacts in hand gain warp {2}{R}: each is cast twice, the second time from exile (a Zuko counter), and the rest of the team gets haste.

Teleportation Circle.text: In the deck. Blinks a creature or artifact at every end step: a permanent entering from exile every turn, plus another trigger of Celes' discard-and-draw, a Blood token from Bloodtithe, or Giant Killer back untapped.

Dream Devourer.text: In the deck. Gives every nonland card in hand foretell at two less, so any card can be cast from exile; a 2-drop enabler that grows each time you foretell.

Chandra, Torch of Defiance.text: In the deck. +1 casts the top card from exile or deals 2; +1 ramps RR; −3 deals 4 to a creature. Impulse, ramp and removal on one card.

Axavar, Fate Thief.text: In the deck. Warps for one mana (a Pirate outlaw); the warp itself turns on its end-step trigger: discard a card, then heist a card from their library to cast from exile. Discard, outlaws and exile in one card.

Trumpeting Carnosaur.text: In the deck. Discover 5 on entering (a free spell cast from exile); from hand, {2}{R} and discard it for 3 damage, which is a discard for Spider-Man, Inti and Magmakin.

Glorious Protector.text: Flash flier with foretell; exiles your creatures until it leaves, dodging a wipe, and when they come back they enter from exile, one Zuko counter per creature.

Sozin's Comet.text: The comet that powers Fire Lord Zuko's army: foretell (cast from exile) and firebending 5 on every creature. That combat-only red mana pays madness costs for cards discarded by Inti, Conspiracy Theorist or Cool but Rude during the attack.

Avatar's Wrath.text: Airbends every creature but one: opponents can't recast for a turn, and yours come back for {2} each from exile, one Zuko counter per cast.

Airbender's Reversal.text: Destroy an attacker, or airbend your own creature in response to removal and recast it from exile for {2}.

Bituminous Blast.text: 4 damage to a creature plus cascade, a free spell cast from exile.

Theater of Horrors.text: An exiled card every upkeep, playable once an opponent has lost life; Spider-Man, Magmakin and Glint-Horn turn that on.

Tersa Lightshatter.text: Haste; enters discarding up to two then drawing that many, and attacks play a card from the graveyard via exile once seven are there.

Rev, Tithe Extractor.text: Rogue outlaw; combat damage makes a Treasure and exiles their top card for you to cast.

Restoration Angel.text: Flash blink: a permanent re-entering from exile, at instant speed.

Quantum Entanglement.text: Flash; repeatable {1}{W} blink at each end step.

Slickshot Show-Off.text: Plot for {1}{R}, cast free later from exile; a hasty flier that grows on noncreature spells.

Highway Robbery.text: Discard a card to draw two, or plot it and cast it free from exile later.

Exalted Sunborn.text: Warp {1}{W}, then cast again from exile; doubles tokens (Bone Miser Zombies, Mercenaries).

Nova Hellkite.text: Warp a hasty flier that pings a creature, then recast it from exile.

Chandra, Dressed to Kill.text: +1 exiles the top card and casts it if red, which is most of this deck.

Geological Appraiser.text: Discover 3 when cast; free spell from exile.

Black Market Connections.text: Every first main phase choose any of: a Treasure (1 life), a card (2 life), or a 3/2 changeling Mercenary (3 life), an outlaw that is every creature type. Ramp, draw and bodies on one enchantment; owned.

Heroes for Hire.text: Three Treasures at once, and each Treasure can instead be sacrificed to exile your top card and play it, which is a cast from exile. It turns the Treasure subtheme into impulse draw.

Bonehoard Dracosaur.text: A first-strike flier that exiles two cards every upkeep for you to play from exile; it makes a Treasure for a nonland and a 3/1 for a land. Card advantage and ramp every turn.

Ultimate Green Goblin.text: Discard a card every upkeep, then make a Treasure: a free discard outlet for madness, Spider-Man and Inti, plus ramp. Mayhem lets you recast it if you discard it. Owned.

Impetuous Lootmonger.text: Rogue outlaw: discard on entering, then heist a card from their library to cast from exile; casting their card makes a Treasure. Owned.

Collector's Vault.text: A 2-mana rock in the Talismans' slot: {2},{T}: loot and make a Treasure, so every activation is a discard and refunds most of its cost. Owned.

Goldspan Dragon.text: Hasty flier; a Treasure on attack and whenever targeted, and Treasures tap for two mana. Strong with Prosper, Crucias and Face-Breaker already making Treasures.

Breeches, Eager Pillager.text: Pirate outlaw; each Pirate attack picks a mode: Treasure, can't block, or impulse a card. Axavar, Crucias, Ragavan, Glint-Horn and Magmakin are Pirates.

Grim Hireling.text: Rogue outlaw: two Treasures whenever your creatures connect, and spends Treasures as -X/-X removal. Owned.

Decadent Dragon.text: Adventure steals two of their cards to play from exile, then the dragon itself is cast from exile and makes a Treasure on every attack. Owned.

Pirate's Pillage.text: Discard a card as a cost, draw two and make two Treasures; a sorcery Big Score.

Unexpected Windfall.text: The instant version of Pirate's Pillage at {2}{R}{R}.

Smaug, Wicked Worm.text: Draws a card for each spell paid with Treasure mana, but its own Treasures depend on opponents' artifacts. Owned.

Season of the Bold.text: Up to five Treasures, or impulse two, or a mix. Owned.

Quark, Humble Proprietor.text: A Treasure every upkeep, but you CAN'T sacrifice Treasure tokens, which switches off the mana and Face-Breaker, Prosper and Olivia's uses. Fights the subtheme. Owned.

Drill Bit.text: One-shot hand attack. The OPPONENT discards, which triggers none of this deck's discard payoffs (rule 10).

Reckoner Shakedown.text: Opponent discard or two counters; one-shot, off the engine (rule 10).

Azula, Ruthless Firebender.text: A repeatable attack-trigger discard on a 3-drop, and firebending 1 gives combat red mana to pay madness for the card it just discarded. Pumps off experience.

Hostile Investigator.text: Once a turn, ANY player discarding makes a Clue: our own discards count, so it is card advantage off the engine plus an artifact.

Waste Not.text: Pays off only OPPONENTS discarding; this deck makes them discard rarely (rule 10).

Tomb Robber.text: Pirate (outlaw) with a {1} repeatable discard outlet that explores, so it grows or draws lands.

Dying to Serve.text: A tapped 2/2 each turn you discard, which is most turns here; bodies for Zuko's counters.

The Death of Gwen Stacy.text: Chapter I destroys a creature; II lets every player discard (ours feeds madness and the payoffs, theirs costs 3 life if they won't); III exiles graveyards.

Heartless Pillage.text: Opponent discards two, plus a Treasure if you attacked; hand attack, so off the engine (rule 10).

Ozai's Cruelty.text: 2 damage and the opponent discards two; flavourful for an Avatar deck but off the engine (rule 10).

Ninja's Blades.text: Loot on combat damage per equipped creature, draining by the discarded card's mana value; equip {2}.

Ral Zarek, Guest Lecturer.text: −1 can make YOU discard as well as them; −2 returns a 3-drop from the graveyard (a Celes card, rule 2).

Kroxa and Kunoros.text: Reanimates on entering and attacking: a strong CELES card (rule 2), but nothing for Zuko (rule 1).

Ruinous Ultimatum.text: One-sided wipe of every nonland permanent; WWW with 19 white sources makes it a late card.

Lorehold, the Historian.text: Hasty flier; loots in EACH opponent's upkeep, so a madness card discarded there is cast at instant speed; instants and sorceries gain miracle {2}.

Killian, Spotlight Chaser.text: Noncombat damage to an opponent seeks a card, which is discarded at end step: a forced discard each time Spider-Man, Magmakin, Glint-Horn or Nico deal damage.

Chainer, Nightmare Adept.text: Discard to cast a creature from the GRAVEYARD: a Celes engine (rule 2), not a Zuko one.

Inevitable Defeat.text: Instant, uncounterable exile of any nonland permanent plus a 3-point drain; a better answer than sorcery Vindicate.

Carnival // Carnage.text: Carnival is a 1-mana ping; Carnage makes them discard two (rule 10).

Merciless Javelineer.text: {2}, discard: a -1/-1 counter and can't block. A repeatable outlet that is also removal for X/1s and evasion.

Quintorius, History Chaser.text: +1 discards to draw two; a 3/2 Spirit whenever cards LEAVE your graveyard, which Containment Construct, Moonstone and Conspiracy Theorist do every time they exile a discard.

Neriv, Crackling Vanguard.text: Exiles cards on attack, playable only in a turn you attacked with your commander; Zuko attacks, so it works if he is out.

Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger.text: Escape casts it from the graveyard (Celes, rule 2); its punisher is opponent discard.

Intruder's Inquisition.text: One-sided fight for {B}{R}; the discard rider is theirs.

Thorna and Twigtooth.text: Removes counters to drain, which spends Zuko's counters.

Bullseye, Death Dealer.text: Discard a nonland card: 2 damage to any target, repeatable for {3}; an outlet that is reach and removal.

Worf, Defiant Commander.text: Whenever you attack, exile the top card (one opponent in Brawl) to play until your next end of turn, plus a hasty 2/1.

Tinybones, Trinket Thief.text: Draws only when an OPPONENT discarded (rule 10).

Tourach, Dread Cantor.text: Grows only when an OPPONENT discards; kicked, it makes them discard two (rule 10).

Neriv, Heart of the Storm.text: Creatures that entered THIS turn deal double damage. Tannuk's warp and haste make every red creature that kind of attacker, and madness and adventure creatures enter mid-turn.

Ob Nixilis, the Adversary.text: Casualty copies it; +1 is opponent discard-or-lose-2 (rule 10).

Tinybones, Bauble Burglar.text: Opponents' discards go to exile for you to cast (a Zuko trigger), but only if you make them discard (rule 10).

Green Goblin, Back for More.text: Each combat you discard (repeatable) and each opponent discards; a 5-mana flier with menace. Mayhem is a graveyard cast (rule 1).

Junji, the Midnight Sky.text: A death trigger: opponent discard or a reanimation; strong body, off the engine.

Maha, Its Feathers Night.text: Opponents' creatures have base toughness 1, so Spider-Man, Bullseye, Kolaghan's Command, Fiery Temper and every ping become removal. Ward is a discard for them.

Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lant.text: Steals permanents opponents discard or sacrifice; needs hand attack (rule 10).

Witch-king of Angmar.text: A flier whose own discard outlet makes it indestructible; punishes creatures that hit you. Owned.

The Eldest Reborn.text: Edict, opponent discard, then reanimation from any graveyard (a Celes card, rule 2).

Armus, Skin of Evil.text: Seven mana as a creature, but {2}{B} and discard it from hand for -4/-4: a discard that is removal, like Carnosaur.

Gamble.text: {R}: tutor for any card, then discard at random. Finds Tannuk or Containment Construct, and a random discard can hit a madness card.

Lightning Axe.text: {R}, discard a card: 5 damage to a creature at instant speed. The discard is the cost, so it feeds the payoffs and madness.

Artist's Talent.text: Loots on every noncreature spell; level 2 reduces costs; level 3 adds 2 to every noncombat damage (Spider-Man, Magmakin, Glint-Horn). Owned.

Lady Spider, Maybelle Reilly.text: Counters go only on Spiders; Spider-Man and itself are the only ones.

Misty Knight, Hero for Hire.text: {2},{T}, discard: draw for each card discarded this turn. An outlet that turns a big discard turn into cards.

Ambergris, Citadel Agent.text: Attack: discard your hand, draw two. A big discard count, but it shrinks the hand.

Captain James T. Kirk.text: On entering and attacking: loot, a token or a team pump, and all three with an empty hand. Owned.

Collective Defiance.text: Escalate: wheel YOUR hand (a big madness turn), 4 to a creature, 3 to the opponent; one card, three useful modes.

Kardum, Patron of Flames.text: Seeks a card per attack and makes you discard them at end step if it dies.

Jaxis, the Troublemaker.text: Discard: a hasty token copy of a creature (draws when it dies); sorcery speed.

Neheb, Dreadhorde Champion.text: Combat damage: discard any number, draw that many and add that much red. A large discard turn plus mana.

Smellerbee, Rebel Fighter.text: Haste for the team; attacks to discard your hand and draw one per attacker. Owned.

Solphim, Mayhem Dominus.text: Doubles noncombat damage to opponents and their permanents (Spider-Man, Magmakin, Glint-Horn, Bullseye, Nico, Shadow of the Goblin); discard two for an indestructible counter. Owned.

Jiang Yanggu, Alone.text: Loots only when a creature attacks ALONE, which a go-wide attacking deck rarely does. Owned.

Mishra, Claimed by Gix.text: Drains per attacker; melds only with Phyrexian Dragon Engine. Owned.

Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant // Phoenix, W.text: Enters looting two; transforming exiles and returns it (enters from exile, a Zuko trigger), and Phoenix's III reanimates and flips it back from exile again. Owned.

Cloudshift.text: One-mana blink: a permanent entering from exile and another enters trigger (Celes, Joshua, Kirk, Bullseye).

Daydream.text: Blink with a counter, twice with flashback. Owned.
